experiments.question: Does improved physical connectivity improve delivery performance when agents initially have limited spatial knowledge?
explanation: 56 changed cells: 56 passage. Per-cell costs shown use the Courier profile, excluding moving occupants.
B sensed 56/56 modified cells; entered 56 (56 entered by couriers). Sensing a blocked cell is different from entering it.
Recorded initial states match: controlled agents, empty memory, assignments, headings, sensing, seed and pedestrian starts.

4/4 actual agent trails differ in cell sequence. 7/8 matched completed delivery routes differ; 0 completed trips lack a completed counterpart. These comparisons exclude timing when checking route equality.

Success A/B: 8/8 → 8/8. Mean successful time: 31.55 → 39.85 simulated s. Weighted travel cost: 1,010.2 → 1,277.3. All-agent coverage: 40.982% → 50.268%. Recorded coverage differs by 9.286 percentage points; coarser rounding may hide this.
Trails include exploration, avoidance and post-delivery yielding; completed-delivery routes exclude yielding. These measurements do not identify a unique causal cell when several cells changed.
